text:
leah.docs: Opened a docs PR: compact 'Private install tips' appendix. Covers HSM pkcs11 path guidance, minimal egress for semi-airgapped sites, and tiny SDK conn-check snippets. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/5072
tom.eng: Please keep examples as diffs and placeholders only. Add a line about exporting key-wrap metadata before migration.
ana.sec: Security: add explicit 'do not check in keys/creds' note and recommend least-privilege operator accounts.
ryan.sre: From SRE: include MTU and NAT hairpin troubleshooting hints for baremetal. Suggest a one-line systemd drop-in for PKCS11 env when module is on removable storage.
leah.docs: Dropping a minimal diff instead of full config to avoid secrets:```diff
- kms:
-   type: managed
-   endpoint: https://kms-managed.example
+ kms:
+   type: pkcs11
+   pkcs11_module: /opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so
+   slot: 1
+   label: redwood-kms
```
tom.eng: Wording tweak: use 'configure pkcs11 plugin path via the KMS connector' not 'open pkcs11'. Also please include Node and Python conn-check snippets pointing to a private.local host.
leah.docs: Node snippet:```js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference');
const c = new RedwoodClient({ baseURL: 'https://private.local' });
await c.connCheck({ host: '10.0.0.5', port: 443 });
```
leah.docs: Python snippet:```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(base_url='https://private.local')
print(client.conn_check('10.0.0.5', 443))
```
ana.sec: LGTM. Add a key-rotation caveat: snapshot HSM policies before rotating and validate on staging.
ryan.sre: Minimal egress CIDRs for staging: 203.0.113.0/24:443, 198.51.100.0/24:443. Add DNS fallback note.
ci-bot: linkcheck: 0 broken links, 1 warning (external http).
leah.docs: Fixed http->https and wrapped long lines. Will squash & merge after quick peer QA. PR description notes docs-only changes.
